body:
Triage: `P6`, `enhancement`, `area:ui`, `effort:medium`.

Why: the maintainer did not ask for this work in his own words, so it is not `P4`. It is an accepted enhancement. The work moves settings between existing UI pages and adds one window. One crate and a known pattern give `effort:medium`.

Facts from upstream/main b2afd64ed (Codex issue worker, no claim):

- The Theme door no longer holds the line width and the anti-aliasing. They are in the viewport Display menu, group "Graphics" (#2818, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/display_menu.rs`).
- A "Settings" button is now in the ribbon top band, near Home and Donate (#2428, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/settings_drop.rs`). It opens a dropdown with one row: "Check for updates" (`prefs.json`).
- "Show origin names" is still in the browser pane (`browser_pane.rs`).
- "Import tool holders" is still on the Tool library page. "Offline only" is still in the AI Chat.

The "Done means" of this issue is the maintainer's answers to the four questions, then sub-issues. That is a maintainer decision, not code. I did not claim the issue and I did not write code.

A possible direction for the maintainer: make the existing Settings dropdown open the Settings window. The window would then hold "Check for updates" too. The maintainer decides.

Answers to the four questions, from the owners of the UI work (qsmits and the user, 2026-11-28; the maintainer gave the UI changes to them, see #4245). This is step 1, PR F of the UI plan #4245.

1. **Window or dock panel:** a separate window (not a dock panel). It opens from the existing Settings button in the ribbon top band (#2428), and from a "Settings…" row in the new menu bar (PR E, #4490). A dock panel takes workspace for a window that is seldom open.
2. **Apply at once or OK / Cancel:** apply at once, as the theme picks do now. Each section has "Reset to defaults". The settings stay per-user (`prefs.json`, `view.json`), outside the project file and the undo history (#877).
3. **What moves and what stays:**
   - Move into the window: line width and anti-aliasing (from the viewport Display menu, group "Graphics"), "Show origin names" (from the browser pane), "Import tool holders" (from the Tool library page), "Offline only" (from the AI Chat), "Check for updates" (from the Settings dropdown), and a read-only Graphics device section (adapter, backend, sample counts; the preferred GPU behind `--gpu` comes later).
   - Stay as quick switches: the Theme door (theme and colour vision; it can also open the Appearance section), and the Display menu toggles that are part of normal viewing (the Graphics group moves out).
   - A setting that moves is removed from its old place, except the two quick switches above.
4. **MCP tool or CLI flag:** none now. The rule "Commands ship with an MCP tool" is about document commands; these settings are per-user and not on the undo history. A later follow-up can add one if agents need it.

Sub-issues follow: the window with the Appearance, Graphics, Graphics device and update sections (F1), then the moves of the other settings into it (F2).
